payload.text: Hi, I'd like to request a refill.
Of course. What is the name and strength of the medication you need refilled?
It's the little white tablet. I don't know the name.

Your chart lists Examplemed 5 mg tablets and Examplemed 10 mg tablets and Othermed 20 mg tablets. I need to verify which one you take. Can you confirm the name and strength from your bottle or medication list?
I'm still not sure which one. I don't have my bottle or medication list.
Would you like me to ask the refill team to review this and call you?
Yes, please ask the team to call me.
